title: Average runtime by director country
statementMd:
Average movie runtime per director country, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `country`, `avg_runtime`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join movies to directors, group by country.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.country, ROUND(AVG(m.runtime_minutes), 1) AS avg_runtime FROM movies m JOIN directors d ON d.id = m.director_id GROUP BY d.country;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
